comparison.objective: Tip a recessed book from a packed shelf and place it on a mat without disturbing neighbors.
comparison.physical_skill: Exploit a head edge to create a grasp, then regrasp and transfer a large rigid object.
comparison.success_condition: Book safely rests on mat, neighboring books remain standing, speed limit respected and grippers released.
comparison.reason: Tests access creation and regrasp in a packed row; no tool impact, force-threshold fracture or small-fragment recovery is involved.
